sonnet.problem: This card tells the warriors being captured and their bows broken. That is war violence under the LORD's judgment, yet it carries a joke about the junk drawer.
sonnet.rule: **Heavy moments.** A card that tells death, violence, abuse, serious sin or the body's private matters has no joke.

sonnet.problem: The question says the people get out of Babylon "so they can save their lives." Verse 45 gives two separate commands, "Come out of her, My people! Save your lives…", and does not say one is the purpose of the other. The card adds that link.
sonnet.rule: **Leave open what the text leaves open.** Who is being spoken to, why, or how two things connect.
